about.title: Atlas Todo
about.subtitle: Local-first, end-to-end encrypted productivity workspace
about.missionTitle: Built for focus, speed, and privacy
about.missionDescription: Atlas Todo stores your tasks on your own device first. Changes sync seamlessly using conflict-free data types and zero-knowledge encryption, so only you have access to your data.
about.archE2eeDesc: All personal data is encrypted on your device with strong cryptography (AES-GCM-256 + Argon2id). The server and administrators cannot read your tasks, notes, or habits.
about.archLocalFirstDesc: All data lives locally in SQLite (mobile) or IndexedDB (web). You can create, organize, and complete tasks with zero network latency, even completely offline.
about.archSyncDesc: State synchronization uses Hybrid Logical Clocks and deterministic Last-Write-Wins rules, guaranteeing that concurrent edits from multiple devices converge reliably without data loss.
about.archPrivacyDesc: No trackers, advertising cookies, or third-party analytics are embedded. Your data belongs exclusively to you, with one-click JSON export and import.
about.licenseDesc: Atlas Todo is licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License (AGPL-3.0).
about.acknowledgements: Built with appreciation for the open source ecosystem, including React Native, Expo, SQLite, Lucide Icons, NativeWind, and i18next.

storage.title: Keep your data on this device
storage.body: Atlas keeps your tasks in this browser so the app works offline. The browser may delete that data to free up space, and Safari deletes it after seven days without a visit, losing changes that haven't synced yet. Allowing persistent storage asks the browser to keep it.
storage.refused: Your data stays, but the browser may still clear it under pressure. Chrome and Edge decide on their own from how often you use the site, so bookmarking or installing Atlas helps. Settings → Data can ask again later.
